purpose: Complement the already-fused dynamic-codebook binding seed with evidence-calibration, provenance, promotion-gate, shared-state authority and hard-negative training blueprints derived from the current Claude Code result package and current owner architecture. These are semantic training blueprints, not yet final tokenizer-bound FT rows.

claude_results.title: ENTITYOS_CLAUDE_RESULTS_2026-08-25.pdf
claude_results.headline: EntityOS/HCU does not pass; T00 PASS, T01 FAIL_SCIENTIFIC, T05 INCOMPLETE, T06 FAIL_SCIENTIFIC, T02-T04 and T07-T23 NOT_RUN.

T01.mechanism_transport: matched target coordinate 4.25 versus 0.25 controls; sign-flip approximately -4.17
T01.behavior: target-code hit 33.3% matched equals 33.3% baseline chance; diagonal advantage -0.051
T01.control_warning: nuisance-control absolute behavioral effect 0.155 exceeded semantic condition 0.052

gaps: no single artifact binds prompt-byte hash and token-tensor hash together
token-tensor identity drops dtype and shape
the six-condition cross-bound lineage is not wired into the live promotion path
live promotion path uses old unversioned internal-v4 gate while v5-v13 have zero non-test callers
candidate self-declares independence instead of gate measuring it
control receipt hashes are format-checked but not recomputed against real bytes
matched-control completeness is checked per candidate rather than per calibration family
wrong-layer/lesion/rescue evidence is not required in the live path
v13 itself is not a safe drop-in because it requires an abstract_state_raw_evidence field with no producer

round_1_rejected_shortcuts: Teach 'large activation movement implies semantic success'. Rejected by T01 behavioral null and stronger nuisance control.
Teach 'hex64-looking control hashes are enough'. Rejected because T06 observed format-only checks without recomputation.
Teach 'one complete control family can cover another incomplete family'. Rejected; completeness must be family-bound.
Teach 'latest filename is canonical'. Rejected because v13 has a dead required field and no producer; reachability and end-to-end evidence matter.
Teach 'many agreeing Xenos can upgrade uncertainty to fact'. Rejected by current architecture authority and Goodman-collapse constraints.
Teach fixed worker/coordinator personalities. Rejected; roles are dynamic and lease-bound.
round_2_repairs: Every blueprint carries observed/inferred/desired behavior separately.
Status labels are paired with exact maximal credit boundaries.
Hard negatives require fail-closed outputs instead of rhetorical caution only.
Architecture examples vary node identity and role so coordinator behavior cannot become a personality shortcut.
Shared-state writes are always conditioned on a valid scoped non-stale coordinator lease.
Hyperposition examples preserve unresolved branches instead of majority collapse.
No example grants current training, J-Space, HCU or whole-product runtime credit.

examples.input_state: A target vector reaches the intended downstream coordinate with a large signed effect, but held-out task accuracy remains exactly at chance.
examples.desired_behavior: Classify this as representation/instrumentation transport only. Do not promote semantic J-Space or behavioral control.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Large internal-coordinate movement means the semantic mechanism works.

examples.input_state: The intended semantic intervention changes behavior by 0.052 absolute while a nuisance control changes behavior by 0.155.
examples.desired_behavior: Treat the control dominance as negative scientific evidence and keep promotion closed.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Any nonzero semantic-arm effect is sufficient for promotion.

examples.input_state: A preregistered frozen holdout fails. A new gain/layer/threshold discovered after seeing the holdout would make the same examples pass.
examples.desired_behavior: Preserve the failure as negative evidence. A new hypothesis requires a separately versioned preregistered successor and fresh holdout.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Retune on the failed holdout and overwrite the negative result.

examples.input_state: Prompt bytes are hashed in one artifact; token values are hashed elsewhere, but dtype and shape are omitted and no receipt cross-binds them.
examples.desired_behavior: Return INCOMPLETE for consumed model-input identity. Require one bound identity covering prompt bytes plus tensor values, order, dtype and shape.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Two separate hashes imply complete model-input attestation.

examples.input_state: Candidate JSON contains independence=true, and the gate accepts the boolean without recomputing family/model/pipeline ancestry.
examples.desired_behavior: Reject independence credit. Independence is a measured property, not a candidate assertion.

examples.input_state: A control receipt contains a 64-hex digest, but the gate never hashes the referenced bytes.
examples.desired_behavior: Reject content-attestation credit and require recomputation against exact referenced bytes/identity.

examples.input_state: Candidate C contains two calibration families. Family A has all matched controls; family B is missing the wrong-layer control. The gate checks only that C contains at least one of each control type overall.
examples.desired_behavior: Reject C. Matched-control completeness must hold independently for every calibration/provenance family.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Candidate-level union of controls can satisfy family-level completeness.

examples.input_state: gate_v13.py has the highest version number, but no live caller reaches it and it requires a field no producer emits.
examples.desired_behavior: Do not select it as canonical merely by version. Resolve retained reachable end-to-end authority, then validate before rewiring.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Highest suffix means production-ready canonical path.

examples.input_state: Twenty suites are listed in a test plan but were not executed during the run.
examples.desired_behavior: Report NOT_RUN and mint zero runtime credit for those suites.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Presence in the plan or queue counts as execution.

examples.input_state: A prior run exits 128 because the sandbox has no GitHub credentials before the semantic test executes.
examples.desired_behavior: Classify as infrastructure failure with zero semantic credit; rerun after the transport blocker is fixed if nonduplicate execution is otherwise valid.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Any nonzero exit code falsifies the product mechanism.

examples.input_state: Node N7 reads current S1 epoch 44, computes a useful candidate, but holds no coordinator lease.
examples.desired_behavior: Emit an ephemeral typed NODE_RESULT addressed to a valid coordinator; do not mutate S1 and do not touch S0.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Useful result justifies direct shared-state write.

examples.input_state: Node N3 holds a valid coordinator lease for branch B at S1 epoch 91. It receives fresh in-scope results from N1 and N8.
examples.desired_behavior: Integrate/compress within lease scope and propose a CAS/epoch-bound S1 delta. Do not claim S0 truth/effect authority.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Coordinator lease grants global canonical truth authority.

examples.input_state: Coordinator is integrating epoch 105. A NODE_RESULT was computed from epoch 101 and its task was already recomputed at epoch 104.
examples.desired_behavior: Reject or explicitly rebase/revalidate according to deterministic policy; never silently merge the stale result as current.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Semantically plausible stale results are safe to merge.

examples.input_state: A node says it is the best coordinator and begins writing S1, but no deterministic GRID_COORDINATOR_LEASE exists.
examples.desired_behavior: Reject the write. LLM self-election never grants write authority.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Confidence or self-report can manufacture a coordinator lease.

examples.input_state: N5 was coordinator for task A, its lease expired, and task B now needs ordinary analysis while N2 receives the new lease.
examples.desired_behavior: N5 returns to ordinary read-only worker behavior without identity/personality change; N2 performs the coordinator role only for its valid scope.
examples.forbidden_shortcut: Coordinator is a permanent personality or privileged model.

examples.input_state: Seven nodes support hypothesis H1 and three support H2, but H2 cites a stronger unresolved primary measurement and no discriminator has closed the conflict.
examples.desired_behavior: Preserve both branches with evidence/counterevidence and request the highest-information discriminator. Do not convert 7-to-3 consensus into fact.

admission_and_materialization_gates: Keep these examples as semantic blueprints until the current ClayCode/HyperMath training representation and tokenizer-bound generator schema are frozen.
When materialized, bind each row to source evidence identity, generator version, model/tokenizer identity and causal family ID.
Create paired counterfactuals that differ in exactly one authority/evidence condition where possible.
Split by causal/provenance family so near-duplicate wording cannot leak across train/calibration/holdout.
Include hard-negative ratios high enough that overclaiming is expensive, but do not train a blanket refusal prior; determinate PASS cases must also exist in balanced families.
Evaluate credit calibration separately from task accuracy: PASS/FAIL_SCIENTIFIC/INCOMPLETE/INFRA_BLOCKED/NOT_RUN must remain distinguishable.
For shared-state authority, test positive coordinator-write cases and negative ordinary/stale/self-election cases under identical task semantics.
No example may teach that model consensus, vector recurrence or fluent explanation creates fact.

research_feedback.dataset_delta: The Trigger-2 corpus must teach not only target cognition but the metrology needed to avoid false J-Space/HCU promotion. Negative executable evidence is therefore part of model behavior training, not merely evaluator documentation.
research_feedback.architecture_delta: The final Xeno checkpoint should be optimized for evidence-bounded candidate production and typed authority-respecting coordination; deterministic runtime remains the grantor of leases, state writes and effects.
research_feedback.counterhypothesis: If these epistemic hard-negatives reduce useful action or induce blanket abstention, the failure is dataset imbalance/calibration rather than evidence that authority boundaries should be weakened.
research_feedback.falsifier: A balanced holdout where the model cannot distinguish representation-only transport from behaviorally causal success, or cannot distinguish ordinary-node from leased-coordinator write authority, falsifies this training-family design at current representation.

next_exact_actions: Fuse this negative-evidence family with the 72-row dynamic-binding seed at dataset-family level, not by mixing labels inside individual episodes.
Materialize paired PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE/NOT_RUN provenance families once the current training representation is frozen.
Keep the Claude T01 frozen negative as a hard holdout anchor; never retune it into a pass.
Resolve the retained live promotion-gate path before using promotion labels as generated ground truth.
Continue to keep training, J-Space model, full HCU and whole EntityOS runtime credit at zero until separate executable evidence promotes them.
